sisi.depan: A long, raised council bench of dark, polished wood with gold parang batik inlay sits before a towering, flat wall panel intricately carved with geometric cloud motifs.
sisi.kanan: The chamber's curved wall features three tiers of dark wood seating that end at a tall, narrow window screen displaying a digital bamboo forest.
sisi.belakang: A wide, recessed entrance archway framed in carved teak stands at the top of the seating tiers, flanked by two glowing light panels set into the wall.
sisi.kiri: Three corresponding tiers of wooden seating curve along the wall, which is dominated by a large, backlit Galians crest made of polished metal and glowing resin.

tengah: A circular, low-profile holographic projector with a polished chrome finish rests on the floor in the center of the chamber, facing towards the council bench.
atas: A complex, multi-tiered ceiling inspired by joglo architecture features recessed warm light strips along each dark wood layer, with a suspended public gallery running along the curved portion of the upper walls.
